title: R2PG-DM: Relational to Property Graph Direct Mapping
description: R2PG-DM is an open-source Java tool that constructs property graphs from relational databases via a direct mapping. It supports Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, and SQLite source databases; produces nodes.csv/edges.csv/properties.csv outputs, a combined.json for direct import into AvantGraph, and a PG-Schema graph schema; identifies join tables and maps them to edges with properties; and supports progressive execution for enterprise-scale datasets.
